create_HumanoidImitation_env: create a gym-compatible humanoid imitation environment with configurable observation and action spaces
reset_HumanoidImitation_env: reset the humanoid imitation environment with optional start time and noise parameters
step_HumanoidImitation_env: step the humanoid imitation environment with an action and return observation, reward, done, and info
build_EnvRenderer_visualizer: build an environment renderer with keyboard controls, auto-play, and expert weight overlay visualization
create_default_camera: create a default camera configuration with position, origin, vup, and field of view for rendering
